annotations.title: Submit a listing to PayAPI Market

description: Submit a new API listing to PayAPI Market. The listing will be validated, preflighted, and placed in pending review. NEVER sets payment_verified or makes the listing live - PayAPI Market will test it with a real paid call (up to $0.10 USDC on Base). If the test succeeds, the listing receives a settlement-verified badge and appears in the marketplace. Rate limited: max 10 submissions per hour, 50 per day per IP and per payTo address.

base_url.description: Base URL of the API (http(s) only, no localhost/tunnels)

mcp_endpoint.description: Optional: MCP endpoint URL if this is an MCP server

network.description: Only listings that accept USDC on this network: base, solana, algorand, or a CAIP-2 id. Omit for all. Each listing reports its rails in `networks`.

paid_route_url.description: The exact route that requires x402 payment (http(s) only)

payTo.description: Wallet address that receives payments (Base: 0x... address, Solana: base58 address)

provider_name.description: Optional: provider/company name (defaults to API name)

sample_input.description: Optional: sample request body for POST routes

name: submit_listing
title: Submit a listing to PayAPI Market
